active_sql: SELECT SUM(purchase_events) AS purchase_events,SUM(revenue) AS purchase_value FROM dbo.brand_sales_1m WHERE run_id='mock-seed'

query_log.sql: SELECT USER_NAME() AS database_user, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.event_metrics_30s','OBJECT','SELECT') AS can_select, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.event_metrics_30s','OBJECT','INSERT') AS can_insert, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.event_metrics_30s','OBJECT','DELETE') AS can_delete

SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('event_metrics_30s','brand_sales_1m') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT run_id,COUNT_BIG(*) AS aggregate_rows,SUM(event_count) AS total_events,MIN(window_end) AS first_window_utc,MAX(window_end) AS last_window_utc FROM dbo.event_metrics_30s GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY run_id
SELECT event_type,SUM(event_count) AS event_count,SUM(revenue) AS purchase_value FROM dbo.event_metrics_30s WHERE run_id=@run GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_type

SELECT SUM(event_count) AS total_events,SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='purchase' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_events,SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='view' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS view_events,SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='cart' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS cart_events,SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='remove_from_cart' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS remove_events,SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='purchase' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_value,1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='purchase' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='view' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END),0) AS purchase_to_view_ratio FROM dbo.event_metrics_30s WHERE run_id=@run
SELECT brand,SUM(purchase_events) AS purchase_events,SUM(revenue) AS purchase_value FROM dbo.brand_sales_1m WHERE run_id=@run GROUP BY brand ORDER BY purchase_value DESC,brand

SELECT 'events_duplicate_keys' AS check_name,COUNT_BIG(*) AS issues FROM (SELECT window_end,run_id,event_type FROM dbo.event_metrics_30s WHERE run_id=@run GROUP BY window_end,run_id,event_type HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) d UNION ALL SELECT 'brands_duplicate_keys',COUNT_BIG(*) FROM (SELECT window_end,run_id,brand FROM dbo.brand_sales_1m WHERE run_id=@run GROUP BY window_end,run_id,brand HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) d UNION ALL SELECT 'events_invalid_values',COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.event_metrics_30s WHERE run_id=@run AND (event_count<0 OR revenue<0 OR event_type NOT IN ('view','cart','remove_from_cart','purchase') OR (event_type<>'purchase' AND ABS(revenue)>0.01)) UNION ALL SELECT 'brands_invalid_values',COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.brand_sales_1m WHERE run_id=@run AND (purchase_events<0 OR revenue<0 OR brand='')
SELECT window_end,run_id,event_type,event_count,revenue FROM dbo.event_metrics_30s WHERE run_id=@run ORDER BY window_end,event_type
SELECT window_end,run_id,brand,purchase_events,revenue FROM dbo.brand_sales_1m WHERE run_id=@run ORDER BY window_end,brand

SELECT SUM(event_count) AS total_events,SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='purchase' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_events,SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='view' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS view_events,SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='purchase' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_value FROM dbo.event_metrics_30s WHERE run_id='mock-seed'
SELECT SUM(purchase_events) AS purchase_events,SUM(revenue) AS purchase_value FROM dbo.brand_sales_1m WHERE run_id='mock-seed'
